name: Activated abilities of a target — Quicksilver Elemental, Grell Philosopher
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. The affected permanents are the ability's source (Quicksilver Elemental) or each Horror you control (Grell Philosopher); the target only says where the abilities come from (Battlefield.setRefPerm; the 'Abilities from' picker), so the effect is not moved onto the target. The abilities are locked in as the ability resolves: Prodigal Sorcerer loses its ability to Ovinize afterwards and Quicksilver Elemental keeps it. Gray Ogre is not a Horror and gains nothing.

$includes: {T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
{8}, {T}: This artifact deals 4 damage to any target.
